recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the one missing durable part of the FHIR-13722 resolution while preserving later published Appointment changes.
issue_request: FHIR-13722 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification PA resolution to support a title/subject-style Appointment display field by mapping Appointment.description to iCalendar SUMMARY, mapping Appointment.comment to iCalendar DESCRIPTION, adding alias "title" to Appointment.description, and adding patientInstructions for patient-facing details.
initial_application: Commit d777ec203416f644c5658bf99deb6c89dd2cd31b explicitly applied GF#13722 by changing the Appointment spreadsheet iCalendar mappings and adding Appointment.patientInstruction. That initial application did not add the approved title alias, and the current StructureDefinition still lacked it before this reconciliation.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini. Later published PA decisions changed the surrounding source: FHIR-19521 changed Appointment.comment to Appointment.note, FHIR-27849 changed patientInstruction from 0..1 string to 0..* CodeableReference(DocumentReference, Binary, Communication), and FHIR-40254 corrected Appointment.description wording to refer to note. Community searches found no relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Updated source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml to add <alias value="title"/> to Appointment.description. No other source was changed because the iCalendar mappings, note wording, and patientInstruction datatype/cardinality already reflect FHIR-13722 plus later PA decisions.

related_jiras.note: Changed Appointment.comment to Appointment.note, explaining why the current source no longer uses the original comment element name.
Expanded Appointment.patientInstruction from 0..1 string to 0..* CodeableReference with DocumentReference, Binary, and Communication targets.
Corrected Appointment.description prose to point detailed or expanded information to note rather than comment.
